resume_rule.predicate: Exists bundle b with authenticated accepted receipt, sufficient complete evidence for its bounded reentry, and branch-local recomputation making at least one declared reentry action eligible under all remaining gates.
steps: Verify resume manifest identities against persisted files; mismatch fails closed and requires new global snapshot/recomputation, not old assertions.
Receive only admitted requested evidence; authenticate/validate with bundle contract.
Commit supported graph assertions with exact provenance; preserve historical outcomes.
Reevaluate affected branch only against original acceptance gates; append attempt overlays rather than overwrite blocked history.
Recompute global actionability and all independent authority/effect gates.
Apply validated deterministic selector; if only decision-ready human actions remain, use human handoff without automatic Architect execution.
Continue normal planner protocol only under task authorization; never consume Candidate-3 authority or execute downstream work implicitly.
resume_rule.human_only_case: DEC-EXEC may become ready after its complete facts/readiness audit; that permits human review control only, not automatic decision.
resume_rule.definition_only: Receipt IDs in this handoff are contracts, not executed actions or silently added resolution_actions. A receipt task must explicitly use the defined gate before installing accepted evidence.
